description: Inspect assets reported by the configured manifest, runtime registry and available Metro bundle graph. Includes available dimensions, scale coverage, byte sizes, observed load history, audit findings and saved-baseline differences. Size measurement and coverage depend on setup; not observed loading does not mean unused. Use get_images for instrumented runtime image loads. Requires @buoy-gg/assets on the device.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

limit.description: Max records to return (largest first). Default 40, max 500.

unusedOnly.description: Only assets shipped in the bundle but never loaded at runtime.

name: get_assets
